name: Infantry_RemoteRunner
author: Infantry AI
description: Remote runners: the runner link's transport (wss with a pinned self-signed certificate, the runner's listener and the orchestrator's client). Core keeps pairing, credentials, rekey, detach, audit and the allow-lists; this plugin only carries the frames. Off = this machine serves no runner link and `infantry runner add/pair/rotate/detach` say so. Daemon half only.
